title: Cyrus and the Bell
author: Rafael Coldharbour
blurb: Jonah Vasquez, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
